housing-numbers.notes: Excludes Northampton Related Development Area (NRDA). Commitments include completions since 2011, development pipeline, urban capacity and rural allowance. Housing requirement for rural areas is 2,360 dwellings (2011-2029).
Includes Northampton Related Development Area (NRDA) which spans across borough boundaries. NRDA total housing requirement is 39,256 with 16,850 from Sustainable Urban Extensions.

Includes both NRDA portion (3,100 dwellings from SUEs) and rural area portion (3,910 dwellings from SUEs). Total includes housing requirement for rural areas of 2,360 dwellings (2011-2029). Delivery target is higher than assessed need.
